chunks: And We raised him to an exalted station.
ai.seo_question: Who is referred to as being raised to an exalted station in Surah Mary?
ai.summary: While the verse grammatically follows the narrative of Prophet Idris, Shia exegetes such as Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni often link this elevation to the spiritual station of Prophet Yahya (John) or view it as a dual reference, emphasizing the concept of 'Illa' (high rank) in the hereafter. This highlights the divine reward for those who attain closeness to God through piety and prophetic guidance, a theme central to Shia understanding of the Ahl al-Bayt's elevated status.
